description: This file defines the AsyncEventQueue class, an asynchronous event queue used in Spark's scheduler to handle SparkListenerEvents in a separate thread, with mechanisms for starting, stopping, and managing event processing and metrics.

classes.name: AsyncEventQueue
classes.description: An asynchronous event queue for SparkListenerEvents, managing event dispatching in a dedicated thread with metrics and control methods.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Retrieves the configured capacity of the event queue, ensuring it is greater than zero.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Continuously takes events from the queue and posts them to all listeners until a poison pill is encountered.

methods.name: getTimer
methods.description: Retrieves the timer metric for a given SparkListenerInterface.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the dispatch thread to process events, initializing with a SparkContext.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the event queue, waits for the dispatch thread to finish processing queued events.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Posts an event to the queue; drops the event if the queue is full, with logging and metrics.

methods.name: waitUntilEmpty
methods.description: Blocks until the event queue is empty or the deadline is reached; used for testing.

methods.name: removeListenerOnError
methods.description: Removes a listener from the bus if it encounters an unrecoverable error.
